description: The United States Air Force, Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, AFLCMC/WVSS is seeking information from interested companies with the capability to deliver a data migration solution for the 3DEXPERIENCE (3DX) platform. Previous efforts configured the application code to serve as a collaboration and approval platform to support the Government's migration to a digital-based acquisition program. The application integrates data from other supporting applications including Cameo and Teamwork Cloud (TWC) and CATIA.
